subtitle.zh: 由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同决定
subtitle.en: Determined jointly by signal, power delivery, area, thermal requirements and cost

body.zh: 不同的产品目标决定不同的连接路线。图中产品约束的五个维度为：信号—高速路径；供电—电流传输；面积—封装大小；热—散热能力；成本—制造成本。
body.en: Different product objectives determine different interconnect choices. The five illustrated product constraints are signal—high-speed paths; power delivery—current transfer; area—package size; thermal—heat-removal capability; and cost—manufacturing cost.

body.zh: 适合成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要的产品。图示金线连接，并列出：成本更低、适合较大I/O规模、功耗友好。
body.en: Suitable when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important. The source illustrates a gold-wire connection and lists lower cost, suitability for a larger I/O count, and power-friendly operation.

body.zh: 在高密度和高速路径上更有优势。图示焊球连接，并列出：高密度I/O、支持高速路径、散热更好。
body.en: More advantageous for high density and high-speed paths. The source illustrates a solder-ball connection and lists high-density I/O, support for high-speed paths, and better heat removal.

heading.zh: 关键变量如何影响选择

body.zh: 信号：高速路径更适合Flip Chip。供电：大电流需求倾向Flip Chip。面积：高密度封装倾向Flip Chip。热：散热要求高倾向Flip Chip。成本：成本敏感更适合Wire Bond。I/O：I/O规模更重要时更适合Wire Bond。
body.en: Signal: high-speed paths favor Flip Chip. Power delivery: high-current requirements favor Flip Chip. Area: high-density packaging favors Flip Chip. Thermal: high cooling requirements favor Flip Chip. Cost: cost-sensitive products favor Wire Bond. I/O: when I/O count is more important, Wire Bond is more suitable.

body.zh: 当成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要时，选择Wire Bond；当高密度和高速路径更重要时，选择Flip Chip。
body.en: Choose Wire Bond when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important; choose Flip Chip when high density and high-speed paths are more important.

notes.zh: 原图对两种路线给出概括性比较，未提供定量边界或适用产品条件；此处忠实保留原图表述。
notes.en: The original gives a broad comparison without quantitative limits or specific product conditions; its statements are preserved faithfully here.
